scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,metro --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently --names server,metro,ios --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,blue --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run ios --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently --names server,metro,android --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,green --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run android --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names server,metro,ios,android --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,blue,green --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run ios --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager" "npm run android --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json packages/types packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/app
scripts.ci: npm run validate:node-version && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:unused-rules && npm run test:coverage
